landing.heroBody: Mörbius routes your symptoms through specialist AI agents — triage, diagnosis, library, profile — with a mandatory three-stage validation gauntlet. Local-first. Quantum-augmented. Yours.
landing.trustLine: Built for clinicians, expats, and anyone who wants a second opinion at 3am.
landing.rolesSubtitle: Inside Dr·ABC, Mörbius is everything-in-one — the always-on assistant, the diagnosing clinician, the citation-backed library, and the surgical-navigation simulator. Same intelligence, different surface per task.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.body: Always-on across every page. Voice in, voice out. Multilingual (EN · DE · HI). Camera + image upload. Talks back through a 3D animated face.

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.body: Triage in under 4 ms · Bayesian differential diagnosis · imaging consult · prescription guidance — all gated by the Kill & Sorry safety protocol before any patient sees it.

library.title: Library
library.body: Citation-traceable answers from the public medical canon. Hybrid retrieval over Harrison's, Robbins, WHO ICD-10 and ClinicalTrials.gov. Every line tied to a verifiable source.

imaging.title: Medical Imaging
imaging.body: Drop a chest X-ray, dermatology photo, or single-slice CT. MONAI runs DenseNet + Grad-CAM on-prem and returns a structured radiology-style report with a heatmap overlay.

triage.title: Triage in under 4ms
triage.body: ESI 1–5 scoring, red-flag detection, and a clear next-step recommendation — before you even finish your sentence.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic ensemble
diagnostic.body: Bayesian differential diagnosis powered by Mörbius Core with structured tool-use. Engineered to be replaced by a Mixture-of-Experts in V1.

library.title: Library RAG
library.body: Citation-backed answers from public-domain medical canon. Every answer is traceable to a source you can verify.

profile.title: FHIR R4 profile
profile.body: Your allergies, conditions, coverage — stored as a portable FHIR bundle. Export, import, share with your clinician.

imaging.title: Imaging consult
imaging.body: Upload an X-ray, dermatology photo, or CT slice. Vision agent annotates findings with confidence scores.

gauntlet.title: 3-stage validation gauntlet
gauntlet.body: No agent issues a clinical decision unilaterally. Validator → Safety → Privacy. If any gate fails, you don't see the result.

landing.comparisonSubtitle: Classical computers in surgery vs. quantum + classical hybrid AI — where the line moves and what it unlocks.

classical.label: Today's surgical computers
items: Rule-based decision support — IF lab > X THEN flag
Sequential image analysis: minutes per CT volume on workstation GPUs
Drug-interaction checks against a static formulary
Robotic surgery: pre-planned trajectories, surgeon overrides on-the-fly
Pattern matching against the last decade of literature

quantum.label: Quantum-augmented (this platform)
items: Variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) for binding-affinity prediction in drug-target pairs — exponentially faster on combinatorial molecular search
Quantum annealing for radiotherapy beam-angle optimization — minutes instead of hours of plan generation
Hybrid Bayesian inference: classical priors + quantum-accelerated posterior sampling for differential diagnosis with rare diseases
QAOA for surgical scheduling under hospital-resource constraints — global optima where greedy algorithms compromise
Quantum-safe cryptography for PHI at rest — post-quantum signatures on every clinical artifact

landing.comparisonFootnote: We don't run quantum hardware on every query. The Quantum Compute Agent gates by problem class and cost — VQE for a 12-atom drug pose: yes; symptom triage: classical, always.
landing.ctaFinalBody: Free to try. No card. Local-first by default — your data leaves the device only when you ask it to.

insurance.title: Insurance planning
insurance.subtitle: Compare plans, understand your coverage, and plan for what's not covered.

gkv.title: Gesetzliche Krankenversicherung (GKV)
gkv.body: Statutory health insurance — mandatory for residents earning under €69,300/yr. Around 90% of Germany is covered by GKV. Premium is ~14.6% of gross salary, split between employee and employer.

pkv.title: Private Krankenversicherung (PKV)
pkv.body: Private insurance — for high earners (>€69,300/yr), self-employed, civil servants, students. Premiums are based on age and risk profile, not income. Often better waiting times for specialists.

expatCheck.title: Expat checklist
items: Confirm your visa requires statutory or private cover
Compare TK, AOK, Barmer (largest GKV providers)
If self-employed, request a PKV quote — switching back to GKV later is restricted
Ensure your plan covers Heilpraktiker (alternative practitioners) if you use them

expat.title: Expat support — Germany
expat.subtitle: The first 90 days, in English. Crowd-sourced from real expat experiences, double-checked against the BAMF and federal sources.

anmeldung.title: Anmeldung — register your address
anmeldung.body: Required within 14 days of moving in. Bring passport, Wohnungsgeberbestätigung from your landlord, and the Anmeldeformular. Most cities now offer online booking — slots are scarce in Berlin/München; book 2–4 weeks ahead.

krankenversicherung.title: Krankenversicherung — health insurance
krankenversicherung.body: You cannot do almost anything else (open a bank account in some cases, sign a work contract, get a residence permit) without proof of cover. If you're employed, your HR will route you to a GKV provider. If you're freelancing, you choose between GKV (Künstlersozialkasse may apply) and PKV.

steuerId.title: Steueridentifikationsnummer
steuerId.body: Auto-mailed to your registered address ~2 weeks after Anmeldung. Required for your first salary. If your employer asks before it arrives, give them your Anmeldebestätigung and tell them the ID will follow.

bankAccount.title: Bank account
bankAccount.body: N26, Commerzbank, Deutsche Bank, ING — all accept digital onboarding for foreigners with a residence address. SEPA is the giro standard. PayPal works but isn't a substitute for a German IBAN for salary.

findingDoctors.title: Finding English-speaking doctors
findingDoctors.body: Use Doctolib (filter for Sprache: English). Most large cities have expat-friendly Hausärzte; specialist waits can be 4–12 weeks via GKV, ~1–2 weeks via PKV. We can pre-book the first 3 visits for you — see Appointments.

ePrescription.title: E-Rezept (digital prescriptions)
ePrescription.body: Since 2024, GKV-covered prescriptions are issued as e-Rezepte through the Gematik app or your insurance card. Mörbius hands off to the Gematik flow when a prescription is needed — we don't try to issue them ourselves.
